name: Riso
oneLiner: Two-color risograph warmth with paper texture, vivid pink actions, and bold blue structure.

notes: The magenta accent is safe for headings and controls but not for small body copy on paper — keep body at the text role.
Overlapping inks darken: check any pair you add where a muted role sits on the overprint tint.

sources.label: Palette and positioning authored for dsh-uiux; name from awesome-design-skills

primary.base: height: 42px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--uiux-color-accent); color: var(--uiux-color-accentText); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em

default.base: padding: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface)

chip.base: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 24px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(242, 55, 161, 0.35); border-radius: 2px; background: rgba(242, 55, 161, 0.16); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase

default.base: margin: 0; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); background: var(--uiux-color-surfaceAlt)
height: 40px; width: 100%; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 0.9375rem
default.focusVisible: border-color: var(--uiux-color-accent); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(242, 55, 161, 0.25)

do: Print with two inks — magenta and black on warm paper — and let overlaps read as a third.
Offset elements slightly from their grid; registration is allowed to be imperfect.
Keep type tight, left aligned, and large enough that the ink texture never eats it.
dont: Do not introduce a third saturated ink.
Do not use gradients or glow; riso has no glow.
Do not centre long copy or justify it.
antiPatterns: Photographic drop shadows on a flat-ink layout.
